newsitem.title: SWEDEN: INSTANT VIEW - Ericsson H1 results.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Ericsson H1 results.

text.p: responses from analysts to Ericsson's first-half
results, which showed a 44 percent leap in pre-tax profits:
LEHMAN BROTHERS, JEREMY ALUN-JONES "They look fantastic." "The sales were about 10 percent better than we expected." "We will probably raise our EPS estimates by about 10 percent for 1997."
HSBC JAMES CAPEL, NIMROD SCHWARZMANN "The numbers were
extremely strong across the board and much better than expected." "Ericsson remains the global leader. The order book was very strong."

"The result was much better than expected and there was one reason for this: stronger mobile phone sales...But I'm somewhat disappointed that it is taking time (to sort out) Infocom Systems. I'm a bit disappointed there. You can probably not expect a huge improvement there until 1998."

"Ericsson is becoming more similar to companies like Nokia as it becomes more dependent on mobile phones than (mobile) systems. You have to consider if this will effect the way you value the company."
"I will keep my recommendation. I think the entire sector, including Ericsson, has a very high valuation."
